changes.S03: Profile runtime shape, duplicate IDs, company/team/manager references, cyclic manager chains, assignment/task/activity/audit/catalogue/obligation/notification/comment/request/calendar and historical references, timestamps, schedule frequency/date bounds, operation rate snapshots and dependency cycles are rejected before restore. Historical closures may retain inactive actors and task owners need not remain current company members. Added malformed v1/v2 backup regressions for wrong runtime types, duplicate and unknown company/team/profile references, unknown managers, duplicate entity IDs, and cycles through inactive managers; additional adversarial cases and independent review remain open.
changes.S07: Evidence preview reads are invalidated on unmount or record changes; stale reads do not create object URLs and active URLs are revoked.
changes.S08: Recurring-plan replacement rejects pending tasks with dependent links, commercial progress, comments, evidence, notifications, shared dates, joint receipts, transfers, request links, fiscal links or annotations.
changes.S09: Successful restore reconciles the IndexedDB quota index to active state references, retains orphaned bytes, rejects conflicting record scopes, and rolls back local state on reconciliation failure. A shared Web Lock spans evidence blob/state commits and backup restore. The current Edge run verified a second tab blocks both upload and restore until lock release; restore then completed with evidence intact.
changes.S10: Laboratory boot no longer overwrites existing state unconditionally; inaccessible storage opens a read/export path with writes blocked, and theme storage failures fall back to session appearance.
changes.S11: Backup file selection uses a monotonic token so stale reads/errors cannot replace the latest preview.
changes.S16: Activity/evidence submission is serialized, cleanup failure is reported, and ambiguous commit outcomes preserve files instead of deleting potentially referenced evidence. The new explicit commit outcome distinguishes committed, rejected and unknown; failed localStorage writes are classified by reading back the exact candidate and prior state.
changes.S29: Create/reply callbacks return actual commit success and keep drafts on rejected/failed commits.
changes.S49: Activity form has a synchronous submit lock and accessible busy state; DOM regression now verifies a duplicate submit during a deferred evidence upload creates exactly one movement and one evidence reference.
changes.S51: Resolved requests reject late replies before IDs, messages or history are created.
changes.S55: Evidence errors remain visible after permission revocation or panel unmount.
changes.S64: Backup copy limit text now says the 50 MB cap includes data and files.
changes.S65: Known rejected commits compensate fresh files; ambiguous outcomes keep files and report that review is needed. Explicit commit-result contract is implemented in both deliverable evidence and operational activity paths. Integrated App regressions cover exact-candidate localStorage write-then-throw (commit confirmed), definite storage rejection (compensation and precise error), unreadable readback (unknown, preserve bytes, request verification), and failed cleanup recovery without an unhandled rejection. Task evidence covers confirmation-notice failure after committed state. Edge now also aborts a native IndexedDB transaction after a real add request and verifies unchanged metadata/blob counts. Physical disk quota exhaustion and every post-commit operational notification interleaving remain distinct limits.
